notes: data_focus read as yes because the report sets its own symptom counts side by side (children vs staff; EPEC vs norovirus) and tabulates NORS outbreak counts by period from the public download; limited is the alternative reading for a small outbreak series. view_issues: Index cases were E. coli O157:H7, yet all 10 cultured center specimens were O157-negative and the outbreak is labeled EPEC; the link between the index STEC cases and the EPEC outbreak is not explained. 'Small intestine endothelium' likely means epithelium.
